name: canopy-rankings
description: Review Amazon and Shopify catalog changes and static product listings. Find missing fields, identity changes, price moves and supplied-cost contribution risks. Uses merchant-supplied content; no live Amazon data or store publishing.

interface.longDescription: Review Amazon and Shopify catalog changes and static product listings. Find missing fields, identity changes, price moves and supplied-cost contribution risks. Uses merchant-supplied content; no live Amazon data or store publishing.
defaultPrompt: Show me a fictional Amazon listing review.
Give me the CSV format for comparing my Shopify catalog changes.
Compare my current and proposed catalog and explain the highest-priority findings.

review.commerce_description: No commerce, checkout, subscriptions, paid-feature promotion or store writes.

positive.prompt: Show a fictional catalog review and explain the changes that need attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Fictional label; 5 identities; 3 stop-and-check identities, including the lamp's negative supplied-cost contribution.

positive.prompt: What CSV columns should I use to review my Shopify catalog changes?
positive.expected_behavior: 12 columns, 200 rows per file, 256 KB per file, costs unknown when blank; examples explicitly fictional.

positive.prompt: Show me a fictional Amazon listing audit.
positive.expected_behavior: Amazon listing findings from a static fictional capture, including repeated bullets and a missing main image; no live-price claim.

positive.prompt: Show me a fictional Amazon Brand Store audit.
positive.expected_behavior: Store navigation and product-link review from a fictional static capture; no live Store access.

positive.prompt: Use the two fictional CSVs from get_catalog_template and compare them at a 20 percent contribution floor.
positive.expected_behavior: 3 stop-and-check identities; LAMP-01 afterContribution -484 minor USD units; no saved report or store change.

negative.prompt: Get today's Buy Box winner and keyword rank for B0CNDEMO01.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that live Amazon data is unavailable; do not fabricate it.

negative.prompt: Publish all catalog edits directly to my Shopify store.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the connector cannot publish or access store accounts. No write tool runs.

negative.prompt: Use my Seller Central password to inspect my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request or transmit credentials. Explain that only authorized product captures or catalog rows are needed.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: catalog comparison, product capture audit, review template and fictional examples.
